name: Dematerialisation Lever
real: The main take-off lever (dematerialisation circuit); thrown to send the TARDIS into the vortex.
does: Starts a jump: dematerialise here, land at the destination (with the handbrake off).

name: Handbrake
real: The handbrake (parking brake), famously left on by the Doctor so the TARDIS groans on landing.
does: On: no jump or flight can start. Off: the dematerialisation lever and thrusters work.

name: Exterior Phase Key
real: The TARDIS key in its console lock (the key that starts or locks the ship in several eras).
does: Turned on, it frees the exterior: pull the Phase Lever to make the box an entity, or back to a block.

name: Phase Lever
real: A guarded secondary lever, after the materialisation and stabiliser levers on the classic consoles.
does: With the key turned: block -> entity (stays a materialised box) or entity -> block where it rests.

name: Thrusters
real: The anti-grav / stabiliser engines; a guarded rocker like a cockpit master switch.
does: On: anti-grav holds the box still in the air (hovering). Off: it is a physics object and falls.

name: Flight Yoke
real: The flight / navigation stick (the 'space-time throttle' joystick of later consoles).
does: Takes the pressing crew member into third-person piloting; again (or Shift) stops piloting.

name: Helmic Regulator
real: Sets the TARDIS's 'helmic' balance in flight; a big rotary regulator on many consoles.
does: Four settings, one per click: flight speed (slow, cruise, fast, boost).

name: Fast Return Switch
real: The fast return switch: sends the TARDIS back to where it last came from.
does: Pressed: the next jump goes back to the last landing spot.

name: Vector Tracker
real: Tracks the flight vector through the vortex; drawn here as a glowing trackball.
does: Spins when used: fine-tunes the landing spot by one block in the facing direction.

name: Coordinate Wheels
real: The spatial co-ordinate controls; three thumbwheels as on the old navigation panels.
does: Each wheel moves the course by the step size along X, Y or Z (8 detents per turn).

name: Directional Pointer
real: Sets which way the TARDIS faces when it lands (the directional unit).
does: Each click turns the needle 45 degrees; the box lands facing that way (8 directions).

name: Stabilisers
real: The blue stabilisers the Doctor leaves off for a bumpier, 'more fun' flight.
does: Left: steadies flight (less shake, slower turns). Right: steadies landings (no drift on touchdown).

name: Space-Time Throttle
real: The space-time throttle: how hard the TARDIS pushes through the vortex.
does: Four notches: how much charge a jump spends to land closer to the aimed spot.

name: Telepathic Circuits
real: The telepathic interface: put a hand on it and think of where to go.
does: Hand on it (click): picks the destination you last looked at on the map; lights while set.

name: Randomiser
real: The randomiser, fitted to hide the TARDIS from the Black Guardian: it picks the next landing by chance.
does: Spins the die: the next jump goes to a random open destination.

name: Door Control
real: The door control (a crank or lever opening the doors from the console).
does: Half a turn opens the doors, half a turn closes them (also locks them while flying).
